feeds.term: (lecanemab OR donanemab OR "anti-amyloid" OR "tau-targeting" OR trontinemab) AND ("clinical trial"[Publication Type] OR phase OR efficacy)

feeds.title: 机制 · 基础研究
feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND (amyloid OR tau OR neuroinflammation OR APOE OR microglia) AND (mechanism OR pathology OR pathogenesis)

feeds.title: 诊断 · 生物标志物
feeds.term: (Alzheimer) AND ("p-tau217" OR "plasma biomarker" OR "blood biomarker" OR "amyloid PET" OR "GFAP") AND (diagnosis OR detection OR screening)

feeds.title: 预防 · 生活方式
feeds.term: (Alzheimer OR dementia) AND (prevention OR diet OR exercise OR "cognitive reserve" OR lifestyle OR "physical activity") AND (cohort OR "risk factor" OR longitudinal)

feeds.title: 新手村 · 入门综述
feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: Classification of tau status with machine learning models in amyloid-positive cohorts.
drug.zh: 基于MRI和淀粉样PET特征构建的机器学习模型可有效分类淀粉样阳性人群的tau状态。

drug.title: Cognitive-enhancing drugs in Phase II clinical trials for Alzheimer's disease: emerging therapeutic candidates.
drug.zh: II期认知增强药在AD试验中多数疗效有限，突触与代谢策略或成新方向。

drug.title: Exploring the Therapeutic Potential of Chalcones in Alzheimer's Disease: Mechanistic Insights and SAR Perspectives.
drug.zh: 查尔酮母核经卤代或三氟甲基修饰可增强多靶点抗AD活性，构效关系明确。

drug.title: Pharmacological and Clinical Heterogeneity of Anti-Amyloid Monoclonal Antibodies in Early Alzheimer's Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Trials.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样单抗对早期AD疗效有限且安全性差异显著，临床获益需谨慎权衡。

drug.title: Streamlining eligibility assessment for Alzheimer's disease-modifying therapies: Prediction of MMSE scores using the digital clock and recall.
drug.zh: 数字时钟与回忆测试可精准预测MMSE评分，有望简化AD改良疗法资格评估流程。

drug.title: Six-month real-world amyloid PET outcomes after lecanemab: Greater amyloid reduction at the MCI stage than in dementia.
drug.zh: 真实世界数据显示，仑卡奈单抗在MCI期较痴呆期更显著降低淀粉样蛋白。

drug.title: The Clearance-Centered Bottleneck in Alzheimer's Disease: From Coupled Glymphatic-Lymphatic Circuits to Therapeutic Opportunities.
drug.zh: 提出以清除为中心的新框架，揭示类淋巴-淋巴耦合回路三节点瓶颈是AD治疗新靶点。

drug.title: Nanomedicine targeting neuroinflammatory pathways in Alzheimer's disease: a new frontier in inflammopharmacology.
drug.zh: 纳米药物可精准调控神经炎症通路，为阿尔茨海默病提供超越对症治疗的新策略。

mech.title: Cognitive and Biomarker Signatures of Late-Onset Temporal Lobe Epilepsy: Toward Non-Alzheimer Neurodegenerative Mechanisms.
mech.zh: 晚发颞叶癫痫认知与脑脊液标志物提示非阿尔茨海默病性神经退行机制。

mech.title: Psychological and neurological benefits of physical activity: impact on mental health, Parkinson's disease, and Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: 运动经肌肉-脑信号通路改善神经炎症，缓解抑郁并延缓帕金森及阿尔茨海默病进展。

mech.title: Intranasal Administration of Isoeugenol Improves Memory Deficits in APP/PS1 Old Mice-A Role Beyond Nrf2 Activation?
mech.zh: 鼻饲异丁香酚可改善APP/PS1老龄小鼠记忆缺陷，其作用或非依赖Nrf2激活。

mech.title: Diagnostic Accuracy of the Boston Criteria v2.0 in Memory Clinic Patients: An MRI-Neuropathology Validation Study.
mech.zh: 波士顿标准v2.0在记忆门诊患者中诊断脑淀粉样血管病准确性有限，需谨慎解读。

mech.title: [Research progress on active ingredients of Astragali Radix and Acori Tatarinowii Rhizoma and mechanism of their herb pair against Alzheimer's disease].
mech.journal: Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zho
mech.zh: 黄芪-石菖蒲药对活性成分经PPARγ/BDNF及PI3K/Akt等多通路协同抗AD。

mech.title: Gait Impairment and Alzheimer's Disease Pathology: A Narrative Review on Mechanistic Links.
mech.zh: 步态障碍与阿尔茨海默病病理密切相关，或可作为早期临床标志物。

mech.title: Proteomic comparison of hippocampal neurofibrillary tangles in PART, intermediate Alzheimer's disease and advanced Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: PART、中间型及晚期AD海马神经原纤维缠结蛋白组差异揭示Aβ共病理改变缠结组成。

mech.title: The Glial Autophagy-Lysosomal-Inflammation Axis in Alzheimer's Disease: a Unifying Mechanistic Framework.
mech.zh: 胶质细胞自噬-溶酶体通路受损驱动阿尔茨海默病神经炎症与退行性病变。

dx.title: High prevalence of tau pathologies in late-onset psychosis: A PET study.
dx.zh: 迟发性精神病患者tau蛋白病理高发，提示其或为神经退行性病变早期表现。

dx.title: Serum Glial Fibrillary Acidic Protein Dynamics, Disease Progression, and Therapy Response in Multiple Sclerosis.
dx.zh: 血清GFAP动态变化可预测多发性硬化独立于复发的疾病进展及治疗应答。

dx.title: Brain aging clocks: From methodological advances to cellular mechanisms.
dx.zh: 脑衰老时钟已从全局指标演进为多模态、细胞级精度工具，可量化区域异质性与衰老速率。

dx.title: Biomarker-Based Diagnosis and Care Pathways for Alzheimer's Disease in the Era of Disease-Modifying Treatments: A Consensus Statement by Belgian Experts.
dx.zh: 比利时专家共识：AD诊疗须以生物标志物确诊淀粉样病变，血液检测可提升可及性但需防过度诊断。

dx.title: Motor performance and its association with Alzheimer's-related biomarkers: a systematic review.
dx.zh: 阿尔茨海默病相关生物标志物与运动功能显著关联，或可预警认知衰退。

dx.title: Exploring longitudinal relationships among Alzheimer's disease biomarkers.
dx.zh: 血浆生物标志物基线值比其变化率更能预测AD关键结局的进展速率。

dx.title: Anemia, iron deficiency, and blood biomarkers for Alzheimer disease: clinical interpretation and dementia risk stratification.
dx.zh: 贫血与铁缺乏显著影响AD血液生物标志物解读及痴呆风险分层。

dx.title: Classification of tau status with machine learning models in amyloid-positive cohorts.
dx.zh: 基于MRI和淀粉样PET的机器学习模型可准确预测淀粉样阳性人群的tau病理状态。

prev.title: Psychological and neurological benefits of physical activity: impact on mental health, Parkinson's disease, and Alzheimer's disease.
prev.zh: 运动通过肌脑信号通路改善神经炎症与代谢，缓解抑郁并延缓帕金森和阿尔茨海默病进展。

prev.title: A Technology-Blended Exercise Intervention for Cognitive Risk Reduction and Brain Health in Middle-Aged and Older Adults with Type 2 Diabetes in Singapore.
prev.journal: The journals of gerontology. Series A, B
prev.zh: 12周技术融合运动干预可改善新加坡中老年2型糖尿病患者认知风险及脑健康。

prev.title: Cognitive Potentially Inappropriate Medications, Quality of Life, and Healthcare Use in Older Adults With Cognitive Disorders.
prev.journal: Journal of the American Geriatrics Socie
prev.zh: 认知障碍老年人使用认知潜在不当药物与生活质量下降及医疗资源利用增加显著相关。

prev.title: Changes in salivary brain-derived neurotrophic factor following a standardized eating task in community-dwelling older adults: a cross-sectional study.
prev.zh: 标准进食任务可显著改变社区老年人唾液BDNF水平，且与血浆BDNF无关联。

prev.title: Reducing CETP activity prevents memory decline in an Alzheimer's disease mouse model.
prev.zh: 抑制CETP活性可独立于淀粉样病理维持AD小鼠记忆，提示血管保护为潜在治疗新靶点。

prev.title: Neurocognitive Outcomes and Survival with High- vs Low-Intensity Statins in Stroke Survivors: A Propensity Score-Matched Cohort (2010-2025).
prev.journal: Journal of stroke and cerebrovascular di
prev.zh: 卒中后启动高强度他汀未能降低痴呆风险，但显著改善生存率。

prev.title: COVID-19 Impact on Health Behaviors and Survey Engagement in Older African Americans: Longitudinal Cohort Study.
prev.zh: 新冠疫情致老年非裔美国人活动减少、睡眠延长，问卷参与度反升。

prev.title: Reducing Dementia Risk with the BrainSpan Program: : A Public Health Practice Vignette.
prev.zh: “脑Span项目通过多领域生活方式干预，可降低老年人群痴呆风险，且现实可行。”

intro.title: Neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases: pathogenic mechanisms and therapeutic strategies.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是大脑发炎会加重老年痴呆和帕金森病，看懂它，能帮你明白为啥现在还没特效药，以及未来治疗可能往哪儿使劲。

intro.title: Network Biology of Alzheimer's Disease and Related Neurodegenerative Disorders: Molecular Mechanisms and Therapeutic Strategies.
intro.zh: 这病不是单一原因，而是身体里多个坏毛病互相帮凶搞垮大脑；看懂这个，才能明白为啥现在治不好、将来咋防。

intro.title: Worry and Anxiety in the Era of Early Diagnosis and Disease Modifying Treatment for Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这篇文章讲的是，查出早期老年痴呆后，人容易焦虑，而心理医生能帮上忙，让病人和家人少受罪。

intro.title: Pharmacological and Clinical Heterogeneity of Anti-Amyloid Monoclonal Antibodies in Early Alzheimer's Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Trials.
intro.zh: 这药能清脑子里的垃圾蛋白，但效果因人而异，还可能水肿出血，得看值不值。

intro.title: Glycopolymers as emerging modulators of Amyloid-β aggregation: structure-activity relationships and therapeutic potential.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是用糖类聚合物拦住大脑里堆积的“坏蛋白”，帮普通人看懂这类新药研究离治阿尔茨海默病还有多远。

intro.title: Oral Microbial Extracellular Vesicles as Novel Mediators of Alzheimer's Pathogenesis: A Critical Review of the Periodontal-Brain Axis.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是牙周炎细菌释放的微小“快递包”可能钻进大脑，引发老年痴呆，提醒大家护好牙口或许能防痴呆。

intro.title: Peripheral and Central miRNA Signatures in Alzheimer's Disease: Tissue-Specific Variability, Sex-Associated Differences, and Implications for Blood-Based Biomarkers.
intro.zh: 这篇研究想告诉大家，未来可能通过抽血查一种叫“微小RNA”的物质，帮助更早发现阿尔茨海默病，但男女和不同部位的结果有差异，还需更多验证。

intro.title: Analysis of the Efficacy of Acetylcholinesterase Inhibitors in the Treatment of Alzheimer's Disease, Literature Review.
intro.zh: 这文章就是讲一种治老年痴呆的老药到底管不管用，帮家属明白吃药能拖住啥、拖不住啥。
